events.title: 스티버니지 Borough's FA Cup run ends in the fourth round replay when 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat them 2–1 at St James's Park. 12 February 1998 – 첼시 manager 뤼트 휠릿 is sacked after a dispute with chairman Ken Bates . 33-year-old striker 잔루카 비알리 is installed as player-manager.

Five days after his England début, 마이클 오언 scores his first professional hat-trick, as 리버풀 draw 3–3 with 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the top-flight, and 입스위치 타운 were the high scorers of the day with their five against 허더즈필드 타운 in Division One. Meanwhile, on FA Cup fifth round day, wins for 코번트리 시티, 리즈 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 saw them eliminate 애스턴 빌라, 버밍엄 시티 and 트랜미어 로버스 , while 윔블던 and second-tier 울버햄프턴 원더러스 drew at Selhurst Park , and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 face a replay at Ewood Park after they failed to beat a 블랙번 로버스 side who had Kevin Gallacher sent off for an elbow on Eyal Berkovic .
맨체스터 시티 fires manager Frank Clark and appoints Joe Royle as his successor.
토트넘 홋스퍼 sign Algerian midfielder Moussa Saib from 발렌시아 of Spain for £2.3million.
맨체스터 유나이티드's FA Cup quest ends with a shock 3–2 defeat by 반즐리 in the fifth round replay at Oakwell .

February draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the Premier League. They are 11 points ahead of second placed 블랙번 로버스, but third placed 아스널 have played three games less than 맨체스터 유나이티드 who they trail by 12 points. 리버풀, 첼시 and 더비 카운티 are the clubs giving the top three a run for their money. 크리스털 팰리스, yet to win at home this season, are now bottom of the Premier League in a drop zone with includes the other two newly promoted clubs 볼턴 원더러스 and 반즐리. 에버턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 remain under the most direct threat from the bottom three. 미들즈브러 are top of Division One with 노팅엄 포리스트 in second place. 선덜랜드, 찰턴 애슬레틱, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 스톡포트 카운티 complete the top six.
